points.description: States that a single-layer perceptron cannot solve/handle XOR properly because XOR is not linearly separable (it only learns linear boundaries/features).
points.partial_credit: Half if it only says the perceptron fails on XOR without giving any reason.

points.description: States that a multilayer perceptron can solve XOR because it can learn non-linear features/decision boundaries (e.g., via hidden layers).
points.partial_credit: Half if it only says the MLP can solve XOR without giving any reason.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the perceptron fails on XOR (linear only / not linearly separable) and the MLP succeeds (non-linear, hidden layers), in any wording. Give part marks if the right contrast is stated without a reason. Give no marks for reversed or unrelated answers.
